name: Survive in the Facility Revamp
desc:
Welcome to Survive in the Facility Revamp!

2x DNA in weekends UTC Time!

PS: Certain users are able to update games without ID for now, may release some patches here and there.

Inspired by Nebulalition's Survive in the Facility and PenguinDoc9999's Survive in Area 51.

Check In-Game Changelogs or our Community Server for changes! (Your account must be 3 days or older)

🔴Your task is simple, explore what lies in the facility and uncover what lurks within the depths of the halls!
🔴Earn DNA points by exterminating creatures with abnormal natures!
🔴Discover enemies with a myriad of abilities and gimmicks!
🔴Explore and locate brand new weapons to expand your arsenal!

LIKE & FAVOURITE this game to support the creator!

Game may not be suited for Console!

Credits to Nebulalition for approving of this game and creating Survive in the Facility!

Contributors: Helios, Xevnai, Sarcasm, Sapphire, Maxi
